mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS shopId, s.name AS name, s.cover_url AS coverUrl, s.logo_url AS logoUrl, s.rating AS rating, s.month_sales AS monthSales, s.min_order_amount AS minOrderAmount, s.delivery_fee AS deliveryFee, s.estimated_minutes AS estimatedMinutes, s.business_status AS businessStatus, s.next_open_time AS nextOpenTime, s.category_id AS categoryId, c.name AS categoryName, s.notice AS notice from shop s left join category c on c.id = s.category_id where s.id = #{shopId} and s.deleted = 0
